cases.query: Two retrieved passages state different values for the same hive metric under identical conditions; which value does the corpus give?
cases.unresolved_reason: unresolved; verified-final. Adjudication between two affirmative values is not deterministically measurable: test_case3 pins that the layer keeps affirmative claims; only the affirm-vs-negate mirror shape (scored as C009) is resolvable.
cases.resolution_findings: VERIFIED-FINAL 2026-10-23 (previously reported claims; now confirmed against source + tests). The candidate asks: two AFFIRMATIVE passages give different values for one metric — which value does the corpus give? Verified in the running code: (1) the deterministic polarity gate refuses only claims whose OWN covering clause is negated (scripts/test_books_grounding.py test_case2b_number_whose_own_clause_is_negated and its preamble; app/agents/books_agent.py _NEGATION_CUES, _has_negation); (2) test_case3_conflict_claim_with_affirmative_evidence_kept (scripts/test_books_grounding.py:331) PINS that when two passages disagree affirmatively, the deterministic layer keeps whichever claim its own evidence affirms and cites it — 'the deterministic layer cannot adjudicate — that residual is reported, not hidden'; (3) scripts/test_citation_integrity.py TestConflictingSources.test_mirror_conflict_abstains_never_silently_chooses (line 324) covers the affirm-vs-negate mirror shape only, which is exactly the shape executable C009 scores. Consequence: an executable C101 with two different-valued affirmative passages would either manufacture a KNOWN-LIMITATION failure (an expected abstention would contradict production behavior pinned by test_case3) or pass vacuously (no gate can fail on the value choice). The adjudication needed is model-knowledge entailment, the same documented residual as not_covered_here.model-entity-discrimination — measurable only under a live model. Creating fixture_conflict_pair.docx is therefore NOT justified by this task's evidence standard and also collides with the candidate's own review-before-first-use constraint; C101 stays unresolved and excluded from every scored metric. Evidence citations above verified in the working tree at HEAD 08d44b6.

Pipeline capabilities VERIFIED before promotion: ingest_books.process_file treats each PDF page as its own document and preserves page_label; Settings.text_splitter is SentenceSplitter (chunk_size=1024, overlap=200), so each small page lands in a SINGLE chunk and chunks never span page boundaries — therefore the repeated-header page-2 text carries the column association itself and NO cross-page or cross-chunk merge is claimed. The cross-chunk row-split sub-case (a row split mid-cell across a chunk seam) is NOT constructed and remains a documented limitation: with 1024-token chunks it cannot arise from fixture-sized content, and forcing it would require production chunker changes that are out of scope (RAG-AE measures, does not redesign). Evidence text is the actual pypdf-extracted page-2 string (marker line excluded from the scored evidence, as in C010). No new dependency: the fixture is written by the existing standard-library generator.
